verdict.rationale: The Unleash GitHub repo states it supports 15 official client and server SDKs, plus over 15 community SDKs. The quickstart directs users to integrate a client or backend SDK into their codebase, and the docs cover a code snippet (`unleash.isEnabled`), backend tokens for SDKs, and Edge serving thousands of connected SDKs. Missing for 10: per-language SDK reference documentation in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
